column1: Wrestling Dual Meet Box Score: Wilkes College Colonels vs. Lehigh University Engineers - December 3, 1975 AT Grace Hall  Lehigh  University
This box score is a republication of the box score from The South Mountaineer; Published by the Lehigh University Alumni Association on Dec. 9,1975 Vol.

This meet marked the 1975-76  season opener held on December 3, 1975, which stands as a monumental milestone: the first NCAA Division I dual meet in Wilkes College school history.  Wilkes College (known as the Colonels) had just transitioned

its wrestling program up from NCAA Division III.  At the time of this transition, Wilkes was recognized as the smallest Division I school in the nation to compete at the highest level of collegiate wrestling.

The Lehigh Engineers (since 1995 they are the Mountain Hawks) entered the season with  a 5th place finish at the 1975 NCAA Championship and would repeat that feat again at the 1976 NCAA Championships.
In a competitive debut against Lehigh, the Colonels secured  two decisions, a major decision and a draw. The Final score was Lehigh 29 and Wilkes 12
This meet also produced another historic milestone: the first individual match victory and the first team points scored for the Colonels at the D1 level in Wilkes College history.

The first win was secured by a freshmen  wrestler Mat Simone, from Berwick PA. who was competing in his very first career Division I college bout, which produced  the inaugural team points for the Colonel's Division I era.
